_meta.name: SP9 Self-Typing Mismatch — Claimed Type 2
_meta.description: Self-Preservation Nine with a final open response claiming Type 2. Tests SELF_TYPING classification, mismatch detection (claimed 2, engine confirms 9), and self-typing comparison paragraph in client narrative.

final_open_response: I've always thought I was a Type 2 — everyone says I'm very giving and caring

stage0.q1: peaceful, easygoing, go-with-the-flow, steady calming presence
stage0.q2: reliable, kind, sometimes stubborn, hard to read
stage0.q3: stability and presence — I keep things grounded
stage0.q4: I lose my own momentum; I forget what I actually want

stage2.ambiguityAxis: Primary (Type 9) and alternative (Type 2) differ on Hornevian: Type 9 is Withdrawn, Type 2 is Compliant.

stage4.stressDescription: Under stress, Type 9 moves toward Type 6 territory — the client recognized increased anxiety, worst-case thinking, and seeking reassurance from others. This matched Type 9's stress point cleanly.
stage4.securityDescription: In ease, Type 9 moves toward Type 3 — the client recognized increased energy, productivity, and a greater sense of direction and accomplishment when feeling supported and safe. This matched Type 9's security point cleanly.
stage4.habitDescription: The client's habit of mind description matched Type 9's pattern of self-forgetting, merging with others' agendas, and difficulty maintaining their own priorities and sense of direction.
